Returns

Fourteen days from delivery, on unworn shirts with tags still attached. Personalised shirts cannot be returned for a change of mind — only if the print is wrong or the shirt is faulty. Return postage is yours unless the fault is ours.

Refunds

Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 business days of the return arriving. If a shirt arrives damaged or the wrong item was sent, contact us with photos within 48 hours of delivery and we will replace it or refund in full, including postage.
